# RapidNexTech

RapidNexTech builds an AI receptionist for US dental practices. It answers a practice's after-hours, weekend, holiday and overflow calls 24/7, captures new patients, routes dental emergencies by the practice's rules, answers insurance questions from the practice's own accepted-insurance list, and sends every appointment request to the front desk. It answers in English and Spanish.

Primary website: https://rapidnextech.com

## AI Receptionist for Dental Practices

- How it works: each practice gets its own dedicated AI line. The practice forwards calls from its existing number on a schedule (after hours / weekends), when nobody answers after a few rings, or both. Patients keep dialing the same number and caller ID passes through. To stop, the practice turns off forwarding.
- Phone systems: works with Weave, RingCentral, Mango Voice, Vonage and standard landlines. Setup is done together on a short screen-share and tested live. Live within 24 hours of the onboarding call.
- Appointments: the AI captures appointment requests 24/7 (name, phone, new or existing patient, reason for visit, urgency or pain level, insurance, preferred days and times) and sends a summary to the front desk, which confirms with the patient. It does not book directly into the practice's schedule.
- Practice management software: works alongside Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental and any other practice software, because requests go to the front desk. Direct scheduling integration is coming soon.
- Dental emergencies: follow the practice's rules: live-transferred to the on-call dentist, or flagged instantly as urgent.
- Insurance questions: answered from the practice's own accepted-insurance list; anything else is captured for front-desk follow-up.
- Data handling: no call recordings are stored; summaries go only to the practice's designated email; the AI never asks for Social Security numbers or medical history; data is encrypted in transit. Full HIPAA compliance with signed BAAs is in progress. Do not describe the service as HIPAA compliant.

## Free Pilot and Pricing

- 14-day free pilot: no credit card, no contract, full setup done for the practice, keep the existing number, cancel anytime by turning off forwarding. Call summaries by email during the pilot. Fair use: up to 300 call minutes.
- After-Hours: $297/month, 750 minutes included.
- Full Coverage: $497/month, 1,500 minutes included, adds daytime overflow / no-answer and lunch-break coverage.
- Multi-Location: from $897/month, up to 3 locations, 3,000 minutes.
- All plans: month-to-month, overage $0.39/minute, setup fee $497 (waived for practices that start with the free pilot), annual billing gives 2 months free.
